reporting-org.narrative: Siasa Place (SP) is a civic-tech youth-led non-governmental organization (NGO), established in 2015 that specializes in working with grassroots youth, in building institutional structures to support youth participation in politics and good governance. SP targets youth (men and women aged 18 to 35 years) and develops their skills in policy review, supporting the creation of youth-friendly platforms for public participation in decision-making processes, including the budget process and social accountability. SP works in 12 counties including Uasin Gishu, Kakamega, Busia, Kisumu, Homa Bay, Migori, Kericho, Nakuru, Nairobi, Kitui, Lamu, and Mombasa.

title.narrative: Strengthening the Power of Youth Voices quarterly report April 2023 - June 2023

description.narrative: The program implemented various interventions including training of online and Offline County based youth organizations, supporting advocacy follow up for the county based youth leaders concerns, monitoring and evaluation of the progress and creating various platforms for stakeholders dialogues through various forums including indoor meetings, outdoor forums through sports and art dialogue forums, political parties forums, social media forums, students and host community forum. As a result, 10 youth friendly platforms were created, reaching a total of 209,067 through various platforms including 207,970 through social media and 1097(867 men and 230 women) through physical forums. The forums created a platform for young people to understand about their rights and engage the leaders on how they can improve on the service delivery. Out of the platforms created, a total of 31 duty bearers officials attended the forums. The program also implemented the sustainability strategies by implementing the program through the collaboration with county-based youth organizations, initiated mentorship for the county-based youth organizations and establishment of the project steering committee to provide oversight and recommend feedback on the approaches. The program also used monitoring to inform decision making and responsiveness of the strategies implemented . As a result, a safe and institutionalized spaces for dialogue between youth and with relevant government and non government institutions and political actors was created through the establishment of the office of the citizen in Homa Bay, dialogue forums implemented through both online and offline engagements
